headline: Senior Front End Software Engineer
summary: Front-end engineer with 8+ years of vanilla JavaScript and Vue.js, including a cross-browser extension that uses content scripts to manipulate a third-party DOM. Privacy and security advocate; Bitwarden user for 5+ years who drove its adoption across an entire college.

bullets: Led code review and knowledge sharing across a Vue.js front-end, documenting complex solutions and teaching engineers.
Debugged browser UI behavior, DOM, and form issues in a SaaS platform used daily by veterinary clinics.
Owned the GitHub organization and Git workflow, plus AWS infrastructure; reduced AWS costs by over $6,000/month.
Recommended Bitwarden for team credential management, as on every team since.
Shipped 11+ web applications in Vue.js and vanilla JavaScript, including client-side search built on direct DOM work.
Rebuilt the daily login flow, routing users to their intended service after authentication.
Integrated single sign-on via Apereo CAS, including a custom multi-system authentication pass-through.
Convinced the college to purchase and adopt Bitwarden for password management.

projects.name: Taste for Blood Browser Extension

projects.description: Injects a content script into ESO Logs, a third-party site, cloning its native navigation to add a deep link and tracking single-page URL changes to keep it in sync.
